headline: Adobe adds AI agents to automate recurring creative tasks at Max
summary: Adobe announced AI-agent features at its Max conference, including letting third-party AI agents and a Firefly assistant automate recurring creative workflow tasks.

claims.statement: Adobe announced AI-agent features at its Max conference to automate recurring creative tasks.

sources.quote: Adobe is going all in on agentic AI
Adobe is committing itself to the notion that chatbots and AI agents could be your next design assistant, or even automate creative workflows and repetitive tasks on your behalf.
Adobe Firefly AI Assistant can now take on recurring tasks for you
Adobe announced its latest flight of AI-powered tools at its Max conference today.
